title: Setlist Share
description: A share-card generator for your top songs. Pick a song and the card recomposes in the colour lifted from its cover: the old card's type steps out, the new colour settles in and the cover and title rise into place, with no blank frame in between. Copy image or Save PNG renders the card to a 1080 by 1350 PNG on a canvas, and each button confirms with a drawn check.
intent: A real share flow: colour from the artwork, a composed poster-like card, a seamless switch between songs, and a pixel-faithful canvas export to the clipboard with a download fallback.
